headword: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}
gloss: the four cardinal directions; all directions

definitions.gloss: east, west, south, and north; the four cardinal directions
definitions.explanation: The four main compass directions considered as a set. Literally lists them in the Japanese order: east, west, south, north.
Used figuratively to mean 'in every direction' or 'all over the place.'

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えましょう→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's learn the four cardinal directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the cardinal directions with a compass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: In Japanese, it is common to list the directions in the order east, west, south, north.

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: You can go anywhere in any direction.

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧きた。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: He traveled in all directions and learned about the cultures of various regions.

notes:
The order of directions in Japanese is ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧ (east), ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west), ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧ (south), ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧ (north) — different from the English convention of north, south, east, west. This four-character compound uses the on'yomi readings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧: the four cardinal directions
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread in all directions
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからない: to not know which way is which

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧: direction, compass point — the general concept of direction
- ⟦{四方|しほう}→四方：08729_shihou⟧: four directions, all sides — similar meaning but less specific to compass directions
- ⟦{方位|ほうい}→方位：13047_houi⟧: compass bearing — more technical, used with compasses and navigation
